Free, no account, no wallet. Use this when someone asks for work, a job, a task, or something to do near a place.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_work, verify_work, my_work, funding_quote, prepare_funding · Private data: find_work, how_to_claim, estimate_footprint, provision_work, retire_and_certify, verify_work, anchor_proof, verify_anchor, prepare_claim, submit_claim, prepare_proof, submit_proof, my_work, prepare_funding, payment_options, account_statement, payment_preflight · Public sink: anchor_proof, prepare_claim, submit_claim, submit_proof, my_work, funding_quote, prepare_funding.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_work, verify_work, my_work, funding_quote, prepare_funding · Private data: find_work, how_to_claim, estimate_footprint, provision_work, retire_and_certify, verify_work, anchor_proof, verify_anchor, prepare_claim, submit_claim, prepare_proof, submit_proof, my_work, prepare_funding, payment_options, account_statement, payment_preflight · Public sink: anchor_proof, prepare_claim, submit_claim, submit_proof, my_work, funding_quote, prepare_funding

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
